description: This file defines a class 'HTMLPurifier_DefinitionCache_Decorator' which implements a decorator pattern for a definition cache in the HTMLPurifier library. It provides methods for decorating, copying, and manipulating cache objects.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_DefinitionCache_Decorator
classes.description: A decorator class that wraps around a definition cache object, enabling additional behaviors or modifications to cache operations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method for the decorator class. It currently does nothing.

methods.name: decorate
methods.description: Creates a decorated cache object that references the original cache.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Returns a new instance of the decorator, acting as a clone.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a definition to the cache.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a definition in the cache.

methods.name: replace
methods.description: Replaces a definition in the cache.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves an item from the cache.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes an item from the cache.
